name: QR digital menu
title: QR Code Digital Menu for Restaurants in Nepal · FeastoX
description: Replace paper menus with a QR code digital menu. Update prices and availability instantly, show dish photos and ratings, no app for diners to install.
h1: A QR code digital menu your diners will actually use
intro: Put a QR code on every table. Diners scan it, and your full menu opens in their phone browser with photos, prices and real ratings. No app to install, no account to create.

sections.h: Change the menu in seconds, not reprints
sections.p: Edit dishes, prices and categories from the dashboard and the menu updates everywhere at once. Mark a dish unavailable the moment the kitchen runs out, so nobody orders what you cannot serve.
Every dish shows its photo, description and a verified rating with the number of diners behind it. Instead of guessing, guests can see what other people who ate it actually thought.

Each table gets its own QR code, so an order always arrives tagged with the right table. The code carries no prices or personal data, so a printed code never goes out of date when you change the menu.
Prices are shown in Rs., and the menu works on any phone with a browser, including mid-range Android devices on a mobile connection.

faqs.q: Do diners need to download an app to see the QR menu?
faqs.a: No. The menu opens in the phone's normal browser after scanning the QR code.

faqs.q: Can I update my digital menu after printing the QR codes?
faqs.a: Yes. The QR code only points to your restaurant and table. Menu and price changes appear immediately without reprinting.

name: QR table ordering
title: QR Table Ordering for Restaurants and Cafes · FeastoX
description: Let diners order from their table by scanning a QR code. Orders reach your kitchen queue by table, with live status from accepted to ready.
h1: QR table ordering that sends clean orders to your kitchen
intro: Diners scan, pick their dishes and place the order from their seat. Your staff see it in a live queue, tagged with the table, and move it through the kitchen.

sections.p: Orders are typed by the diner, not taken from memory. Staff see exactly what was ordered, with add-ons and notes, so the kitchen works from the real ticket.

sections.h: A live order queue for staff
sections.p: Every order moves one step at a time: accepted, preparing, ready, completed. Staff can mark a dish unavailable, and the diner sees the status update on their phone.
A table can place more than one order during a visit. They stay grouped under the same dining session, so the bill and history stay together.
Totals, tax and service charge are always calculated on the server from your own menu and settings, so a diner's phone can never change what an order costs.

faqs.q: Does the diner have to create an account to order?
faqs.a: No. Ordering works anonymously from the table's QR code.

faqs.q: What happens if the diner taps the order button twice?
faqs.a: The order is idempotent, so a retried submission returns the original order instead of creating a duplicate.

name: Dish ratings
title: Verified Dish Ratings and Reviews for Restaurants · FeastoX
description: Collect purchase-verified ratings on every dish: taste, portion and value. See which dishes diners love and which ones to fix or remove.
h1: Dish-level ratings that only real diners can leave
intro: Restaurant reviews tell you about the evening. FeastoX tells you about each dish. Only someone who ordered and received a dish can rate it, so the feedback is honest and specific.

sections.p: Diners give an overall score and rate taste, portion size and value for money. They also say whether they would order the dish again and can leave a short comment.
A rating is tied to a completed order that contained the dish, with one review per dish per order. Ratings are always shown with how many diners left them.
A dish with a perfect score from two people does not outrank one rated slightly lower by hundreds. Rankings are adjusted for how many ratings a dish has, so the top of your menu is trustworthy.

sections.h: Know what to keep, fix or drop
sections.p: The dashboard shows which dishes are loved, which are reordered and which are quietly disappointing, so menu decisions come from data, not guesses.

faqs.q: Can a restaurant fake or delete bad dish ratings?
faqs.a: Ratings come only from verified orders and are not created by the restaurant.

faqs.q: How do diners leave a rating?
faqs.a: After an order is completed, the diner is prompted to rate the dishes they ate, straight from the order page.

name: For cafes
title: QR Menu and Ordering Software for Cafes · FeastoX
description: A QR menu and table ordering system for cafes: quick ordering, easy price updates, add-ons and dish ratings. Start with a free trial.
h1: QR menu and ordering for busy cafes
intro: Cafes turn tables fast and run on small teams. FeastoX lets guests order from the table while your staff stay focused on the counter and the kitchen.

sections.p: Regulars scan, order and sit back. Your team sees one clean queue instead of shouting orders across the room.
Extra shots, milk choices, sides and toppings are set up once as add-ons and offered on the dishes where they apply.
Rotate specials, hide sold-out items and change prices from your phone or laptop, and the menu is current at every table.
Ratings show which drinks and bakes diners love, so you can put them first and retire what does not sell.

faqs.q: Is FeastoX suitable for a small cafe with a few tables?
faqs.a: Yes. The same menu, ordering and rating flow works for six tables or six branches.

name: For restaurants
title: QR Menu and Table Ordering for Restaurants · FeastoX
description: Digital menu, QR table ordering, staff roles and dish analytics for restaurants. Know which dishes to promote, fix or remove.
h1: A digital menu and ordering system that shows what is worth ordering
intro: FeastoX combines a QR menu, table ordering and verified dish ratings in one system, with roles for staff, managers and owners.

sections.h: The right access for each person
sections.p: Staff work the order queue. Managers edit the menu, tables and QR codes. Owners also control tax, service charge and settings.
Create tables, print a unique QR code for each one and organise them by floor so orders always arrive with the right location.
See best-selling and best-rated dishes, how often a dish is reordered, and which dishes are ordered together.
Create your account, add your menu and print your table codes in a few minutes. New restaurants begin on a free trial before choosing a monthly or yearly plan.

faqs.q: Can different staff have different permissions?
faqs.a: Yes. Staff, manager and owner roles each see and change only what they need to.

faqs.q: How do I get started?
faqs.a: Create an account on the Get started page, add your menu, then print a QR code for each table.

name: POS
title: Restaurant POS Software in Nepal · FeastoX
description: A restaurant POS for Nepal that takes orders at the counter or table, sends them to the kitchen, prints guest receipts and settles bills. Part of one system with QR ordering.
h1: A restaurant POS that shares one menu with your QR ordering
intro: Take orders at the counter or the table, settle the bill and print a guest receipt. Everything lands in the same system as your QR orders, so there is one menu, one order queue and one set of sales.

sections.p: QR orders and POS orders arrive in the same place, tagged by table, so staff are never reconciling two systems at the end of the night.

sections.h: Guest receipts and a customer display
sections.p: Print guest receipts and show the running bill to the customer on a second window on the same computer. Receipts are not IRD tax invoices.
Record how each bill was paid and see sales broken down by mode, including QR payments.
Give staff, managers and owners different access, and require approval for sensitive actions. Every change is written to an audit log.

faqs.q: Do I need special hardware?
faqs.a: No. The POS runs in a browser. Receipts print through the browser, or directly to a thermal printer with the QZ Tray desktop agent.

faqs.q: Does the POS work with QR ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Both feed the same orders, menu and sales.

name: Kitchen display
title: Kitchen Display System for Restaurants in Nepal · FeastoX
description: Replace paper tickets with kitchen and bar screens. Orders move from new to ready, and the table sees the status live.
h1: A kitchen display that replaces paper tickets
intro: Orders appear on a screen in the kitchen the moment they are placed, split between the kitchen and the bar, so cooks work from a clear queue instead of a spike of paper.

sections.p: Send food to the kitchen screen and drinks to the bar screen, so each side works from its own queue.
When the kitchen moves an order along, the diner sees it on their phone without calling a waiter.
Mark a dish sold out and diners see it greyed out with a Sold out badge, so nobody orders what you cannot serve.

faqs.q: Can I run more than one screen?
faqs.a: Yes. The kitchen and the bar each have their own screen.

faqs.q: Does it need an app?
faqs.a: No. It opens in a browser on any screen.

name: Inventory
title: Restaurant Inventory and Food Cost Software · FeastoX
description: Track ingredients, log waste, build a buy list and see dish margins. Recipe-based stock use on plans that include it. Inventory built into your restaurant system.
h1: Restaurant inventory that knows what each dish costs
intro: Track stock by ingredient and let each dish take its recipe off stock when it is cooked, so you can see what you use, what you waste and what each plate actually earns.

sections.p: Attach a recipe to a dish and stock goes down as orders are cooked, instead of at the end-of-month count. Available on plans that include automatic stock use.

sections.h: Waste, stock takes and a buy list
sections.p: Log waste, reconcile a stock take, and get a buy list of what is running low.
See each dish against its ingredient cost to learn which plates make money and which only look popular.
Keep suppliers and what you owe them next to the stock they provide.

faqs.q: Do I have to enter recipes for every dish?
faqs.a: No. Start with the dishes that matter most and add more over time.

faqs.q: Is automatic consumption on every plan?
faqs.a: It depends on the plan. See the pricing page.

name: Accounts
title: Restaurant Accounting and Cash Book Software · FeastoX
description: Sales, receivables, a cash book, recurring expenses and profit and loss for restaurants, kept in the same system as your orders.
h1: Restaurant accounts that update as you sell
intro: Sales are recorded as bills are settled, so the books are not a separate chore. See sales, what customers owe you, a cash book and profit and loss in one place.

sections.p: See sales by day and by payment mode, drawn from the bills your staff actually settled.
Track customers who run a tab and what each one owes.
Record money in and out, and list rent, salaries and other recurring costs so each one is due on time. Due items are posted by hand.
Put sales and costs together to see how the restaurant is really doing.

faqs.q: Does it replace my accountant?
faqs.a: No. It gives you and your accountant clean, current records.

name: Delivery
title: Restaurant Delivery Management Software · FeastoX
description: Manage delivery partners and your own riders, see who holds the cash and who is owed fees, and take delivery orders from a link.
h1: Delivery orders, partners and riders in one place
intro: Take delivery orders from a link, and keep track of the partners and riders who carry them, including the cash each one holds and the fees each is owed.

sections.p: Share a delivery link and orders arrive in the same queue as dine-in.
Keep delivery partners and your own riders as accounts, each with a running balance.
See who is holding branch cash and who is owed fees, so the end of the day balances.

faqs.q: Do I need my own riders?
faqs.a: No. You can work with partners, your own riders, or both.

name: Table management
title: Restaurant Table and Floor Management with QR Codes · FeastoX
description: Set up floors and tables, give each table its own QR code, and see every order by table. Retire a printed code in one click.
h1: Floors, tables and a QR code for each one
intro: Lay out your floors and tables once. Each table gets its own QR code, so every order arrives tagged with the right table, and you can see what each table has ordered.

sections.p: Group tables into floors and keep each one named and numbered the way your staff already call them.
Print a code for each table. The code carries no prices or personal data, so a change to the menu never makes a printed code out of date.
If a printed code goes missing or is misused, rotate that table’s code and the old one stops working at once.
See the orders on each table in the dashboard and the kitchen queue, from the first order to the settled bill.

faqs.q: Do I have to print new codes when I change the menu?
faqs.a: No. The code only identifies the table, so menu and price changes show up straight away.

faqs.q: Can I have more than one floor?
faqs.a: Yes. Tables are grouped into floors.

name: Refer and earn
title: Refer a Restaurant, Earn a Free Month · FeastoX
description: Share your FeastoX referral code with another restaurant. When they make their first payment, a month is added to your plan.
h1: Refer another restaurant and get a month added to your plan
intro: Every restaurant on FeastoX has a referral code. Share it with another restaurant owner, and when their first payment goes through, a month is added to yours.

sections.p: Find your restaurant’s referral code in the dashboard under Referrals, and share it with other owners.

sections.h: A month for their first payment
sections.p: Your reward is added when the restaurant you referred makes its first payment, not when they sign up.
Refer as many restaurants as you like. Each first payment adds a month.

faqs.q: When do I get the free month?
faqs.a: When the restaurant you referred makes its first payment.

faqs.q: Where do I find my code?
faqs.a: In the dashboard, on the Referrals page.

sections.h: A menu that updates in seconds
